title: The best app for organising habits
body: 'Done' is an amazing app! It suits my every need when it comes to organising my daily/weekly activities - for example, I can easily create customised goals for myself and see how I am progressing by viewing the weekly summary (there are charts for each habit). The design is both visually satisfying and very practical because it enables you to quickly scan through the habits that need to be completed for each day/week. I would really recommend getting the premium version because you get so many nice features (e.g. habit groups/categories, multiple reminders etc.), plus you can add unlimited habits.e
